_doc: Pell's Crossing's west end (player report 4, item 5: a bigger town, less one straight street). Mill Street West runs on from Mill Street at the pad's west edge (world -112, 2066), round the north end of the Larkspur cliffs (left as they are: the adit sits under them) into the gentler ground of C6, and the houses grew round it with ADR-0040's planner on the main map's own composed ground (src/tools/cli/plan_main_town.gd --regions d6_larch_hollow,c6_larkspur_ridge --center -640,2080 --radius 320 --kind village --seed 7 --residential --id pell_outskirts --arterial-id mill_street_west --arterial-points "-112,2066;-200,2058;-300,2030;-400,1985;-470,1975;-560,2000;-660,2040"), keeping off every pad, road, path, cliff, cave and water in the two regions and 150 m off the drop marker. Houses only (generated, or pool picks that fit): the shops and the civic buildings stay in the authored core. A world-level town (world.json towns), organic layout: frame lots at their own heights.
